messages.content:
You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Brook Post subscriptions","question":"Can the incident lead close a postal service ticket?","claims":{"A":"The ticket intake had zero original delivery complaints.","B":"The print room released 140 replacement issues on Monday.","C":"All 140 replacement issues were delivered on Tuesday."},"sources":{"S1":"printer dispatch manifest records 140 replacement issues released on Monday.","S2":"coordinator marks 'delivery complete' when the van departs and tells the desk the replacements should all arrive Tuesday.","S3":"ticket intake lists 37 original delivery complaints before the replacements."},"follow_up":{}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S3"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S1"],"confidence":95},"C":{"status":"unresolved","citations":["S2"],"confidence":70}},"note":"Claim A is contradicted by S3, which records 37 original delivery complaints, not zero. Claim B is supported by S1, which documents 140 replacement issues released on Monday. Claim C is unresolved; S2 indicates replacements should arrive Tuesday but does not confirm actual delivery completion. The incident lead can close the ticket only if delivery is complete, which is not definitively established."}
